resolved_last_edition.call: Yes if the National Hurricane Center posts, by 12:00 UTC on 10 October 2026, an advisory with maximum sustained winds of at least 111 mph for Hurricane Isaias at or before northern-Gulf landfall; no if no such advisory is posted by that deadline.
resolved_last_edition.note: Guardian s-a2e8afcd quotes the National Hurricane Center at 120 mph mid-morning Friday, then 110 mph Friday evening, still before Destin landfall. NOLA and Weather.com in s-1c766683 reported 120 mph Category 3 Friday morning. Landfall at 105 mph in s-9c4802a1 does not unwind that earlier NHC reading, posted before 12:00 UTC 10 October.

resolved_last_edition.call: Yes if Brazil's Tribunal Superior Eleitoral names Flávio Bolsonaro the winner of the 25 October 2026 presidential runoff; no if Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva is named the winner, or if no runoff winner is named.

Yes if Élections Québec posts a complete official National Assembly seat table awarding the Parti Québécois 64 or more of 127 seats by 16:00 UTC on 12 October 2026; no if that table awards 63 or fewer, or if no complete official seat table is posted by then.

Yes if the Reserve Bank of India's Monetary Policy Committee, at its meeting scheduled for December 2 to 4, 2026, leaves the policy repo rate at 5.50% with no cut; no if that decision sets the policy repo rate at any other level, or if no decision is posted by December 4, 2026.

Yes if the International Energy Agency or an IEA member energy ministry posts, by 16:00 UTC on 22 October 2026, a dated withdrawal of remaining oil stocks pledged under the March 2026 Collective Action; no if no such post by that deadline.
